"""Shared post67 finite-allocation writer. Old53 ledger never changes.
All new Mac files, including control metadata, are counted/precharged. Two
standing256KiB ledger paths and zero-byte lock are charged from bootstrap;
failed pending metadata is retained and blocks later updates. No refund/reset.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,os,fcntl,hashlib,datetime
BASE=Path('/private/tmp/post67_command_history_unit_v1_20261016')
OLD=Path('/private/tmp/phase5_stop53_combined_derived_budget_v1_20261015/LEDGER.json')
OLD_SHA='94dfdbefb227627e30efb8f35ad946712856ca352462cbf1e48ae39405a876f9'
REPO=Path('/Users/uot/Documents/ChatGPT/ros')
CAP=134217728;COUNT=128;META=262144

def put(path,data,*,category='stage2_preparation',reserve_bytes=None):
 path=Path(path);data=bytes(data);assert category in ['stage2_preparation','stage2_final']
 assert path.is_absolute()and len(str(path).encode())<=768 and not path.exists()and not path.is_symlink()
 assert(BASE in path.parents or REPO in path.parents)and not any(n in path.parts for n in ['.git','.aws','.codex','.agents'])
 assert path not in [BASE/'STAGE2_SCOPE.json',BASE/'bounded_output_stage2.py',BASE/'LEDGER.json',BASE/'LEDGER.next',BASE/'LOCK',BASE/'bounded_output.py',BASE/'ALLOCATION.json']
 path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);assert path.parent.resolve()==path.parent
 charged=len(data)if reserve_bytes is None else int(reserve_bytes);assert charged>=len(data)
 assert hashlib.sha256(OLD.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==OLD_SHA,'old closed ledger changed'
 with(BASE/'LOCK').open('r+b')as lock:
  fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX);j=json.loads((BASE/'LEDGER.json').read_text());assert j['cap']==CAP and j['record_cap']==COUNT
  assert len(j['outputs'])<(COUNT if category=='stage2_final'else COUNT-24),'preserve24 final/archive output records'
  assert charged<=CAP-j['charged'],'finite shared Mac byte allocation'
  stage=j['stage2'];assert stage['scope_sha256']=='582f04169ff224ea0d16405a9a5b1b68197c777665b19693bb54b796cda9ab8c'and hashlib.sha256((BASE/'STAGE2_SCOPE.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==stage['scope_sha256'];assert stage['charged']+charged<=33554432 and stage['records']<32,'stage2 explicit suballocation before output';
  if category=='stage2_preparation':assert datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()<=stage['deadline_epoch'],'stage2 new180s absolute deadline; not old stage reset'
  stage['charged']+=charged;stage['records']+=1
  j['charged']+=charged;j['outputs'].append({'path':str(path),'category':category,'charged_bytes':charged,'actual_bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'precharged':True,'failed_charge_retained':True})
  b=(json.dumps(j,indent=2)+'\n').encode();assert len(b)<=META and not(BASE/'LEDGER.next').exists(),'bounded/fresh metadata; orphan pending is retained'
  fd=os.open(BASE/'LEDGER.next',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb')as f:f.write(b);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
  os.replace(BASE/'LEDGER.next',BASE/'LEDGER.json')
  fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
  with os.fdopen(fd,'wb')as f:f.write(data);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 return {'path':str(path),'actual_bytes':len(data),'charged_bytes':charged,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
